findings.title: Moderate analyzability score
findings.description: Only 78% of skill content could be analyzed. 1 of 3 files are opaque to the scanner. Some content could not be verified as safe.
findings.remediation: Review opaque files and replace with inspectable formats where possible.

findings.title: Skill does not specify a license
findings.description: Skill manifest does not include a 'license' field. Specifying a license helps users understand usage terms.
findings.remediation: Add 'license' field to SKILL.md frontmatter (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0)

findings.title: Unanalyzable binary file
findings.description: Binary file 'resources/shim.bin' cannot be inspected by the scanner. Reason: Binary file (.bin) - cannot inspect content. Binary files resist static analysis and may contain hidden functionality.
findings.remediation: Replace binary files with source code, or submit the binary to VirusTotal for independent verification (--use-virustotal).

findings.title: Binary file detected in skill package
findings.description: Binary file found: resources/shim.bin. Binary files cannot be inspected by static analysis. Consider using Python or Bash scripts for transparency.
findings.remediation: Review binary file necessity. Replace with auditable scripts if possible.
